rules.title: Limit on amounts payable at or before start of tenancy (including to lessor's agent)
rules.requirement: At or before the start of a tenancy, a lessor or the lessor's agent may not require a tenant or prospective tenant to pay more than first month's rent, last month's rent, a security deposit of up to one month's rent, and the cost of a key and lock. Any other upfront charge, including fees paid to the lessor's agent, is prohibited.
rules.key_value: Max: first month + last month + security deposit (≤1 month) + lock/key cost
rules.coverage_conditions: All residential tenancies in Massachusetts; as amended effective August 1, 2025, the limit also applies to agents of the lessor and to payments made to an agent.
rules.exemptions: Vacation or recreational leases or tenancies of 100 days or less.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Does not apply to vacation/recreational tenancies of 100 days or less.

rules.penalty: Lease provisions conflicting with the section are void and unenforceable.
rules.citation: Mass. Gen. Laws ch. 186, § 15B(1)(b), as amended by St. 2025, c. 9, §§ 54-55
rules.quoted_span: (b) At or prior to the commencement of any tenancy, no lessor or agent of the lessor may require a tenant or prospective tenant to pay, to the lessor or to an agent of the lessor, any amount in excess of the following:
rules.conflict_note: Prior version (effective until Aug 1, 2025) restricted only the lessor; amended text effective Aug 1, 2025 extends the limit to the lessor's agent and payments to the agent.

rules.title: Security deposit capped at first month's rent
rules.requirement: A security deposit may not exceed one month's rent, and may be collected only if deposited as required and accompanied by a statement of condition. Lessors may not later demand a deposit exceeding the allowed amount.
rules.exemptions: Vacation or recreational leases or tenancies of 100 days or less.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Does not apply to vacation/recreational tenancies of 100 days or less.

rules.penalty: Lessor forfeits right to retain deposit for violations; treble damages plus 5% interest, costs and attorney's fees for certain violations.
rules.quoted_span: (iii) a security deposit equal to the first month's rent provided that such security deposit is deposited as required by subsection (3) and that the tenant is given the statement of condition as required by subsection (2);

rules.title: Optional fee in lieu of security deposit (by regulation)
rules.requirement: The Executive Office of Housing and Livable Communities may issue regulations allowing an optional fee in lieu of a security deposit; the fee must be optional, offered to all approved applicants without discrimination, and the total of such fees plus any deposit may not exceed one month's rent.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential tenancies where lessor and tenant agree to a fee in lieu of deposit under EOHLC regulations.
rules.exemptions: Vacation or recreational leases or tenancies of 100 days or less.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Operative only to the extent EOHLC has promulgated implementing regulations; applies only where lessor offers and tenant elects fee in lieu.

rules.quoted_span: provided further, that the sum of fees paid to waive a security deposit and the payment of the security deposit shall not exceed, in total, the amount of 1 month's rent;
rules.conflict_note: Statute authorizes regulations; document does not state whether EOHLC regulations have been promulgated or their effective date.

rules.title: Security deposit must be held in separate interest-bearing Massachusetts bank account
rules.requirement: Security deposits must be held in a separate, interest-bearing account in a Massachusetts bank, protected from the lessor's creditors, and the tenant must receive a receipt with the bank name, location, amount and account number within 30 days.
rules.coverage_conditions: All residential lessors who accept a security deposit.
rules.exemptions: Vacation or recreational leases or tenancies of 100 days or less.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Does not apply to vacation/recreational tenancies of 100 days or less.

rules.penalty: Failure entitles tenant to immediate return of deposit; failure to deposit forfeits right to retain deposit and triggers treble damages, 5% interest, costs and attorney's fees.
rules.quoted_span: Failure to comply with this paragraph shall entitle the tenant to immediate return of the security deposit.

rules.title: Annual interest on security deposits and last month's rent
rules.requirement: Lessors holding a security deposit (or last month's rent paid in advance) must pay the tenant interest at 5% per year or the lesser amount the bank paid, annually with a statement; if not paid within 30 days after the year ends, the tenant may deduct it from rent.
rules.key_value: 5% per year or bank's lesser rate
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential lessors holding a security deposit for one year or longer, or holding last month's rent in advance.
rules.exemptions: Vacation or recreational leases or tenancies of 100 days or less.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Does not apply to vacation/recreational tenancies of 100 days or less.

rules.penalty: For last month's rent interest not paid within 30 days after termination: treble the interest owed plus costs and attorney's fees.
rules.quoted_span: A lessor of residential real property who holds a security deposit pursuant to this section for a period of one year or longer from the commencement of the term of the tenancy shall, beginning with the first day of the tenancy, pay interest at the rate of five per cent per year, or other such lesser amount of interest as has been received from the bank where the deposit has been held payable to the tenant at the end of each year of the tenancy.

rules.title: Deposit receipt and statement of condition
rules.requirement: A lessor who accepts a security deposit must give a signed receipt and, within 10 days after the tenancy begins (or on receipt, if later), a written statement of the premises' condition listing existing damage, with a prescribed notice; the lessor must keep deposit records for two years.
rules.coverage_conditions: All residential lessors who accept a security deposit.
rules.exemptions: Vacation or recreational leases or tenancies of 100 days or less.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Does not apply to vacation/recreational tenancies of 100 days or less.

rules.penalty: Wrongful failure to make deposit records available entitles tenant to immediate return of deposit with interest.
rules.quoted_span: Any lessor of residential real property, or his agent, who accepts a security deposit from a tenant or prospective tenant shall, upon receipt of such security deposit, or within ten days after commencement of the tenancy, whichever is later, furnish to such tenant or prospective tenant a separate written statement of the present condition of the premises to be leased or rented.

rules.title: Return of security deposit within 30 days; limited deductions
rules.requirement: The lessor must return the deposit (or balance) within 30 days after the tenancy ends, deducting only unpaid rent/water charges, qualifying tax escalation amounts, and reasonable repair costs for tenant-caused damage beyond normal wear and tear, supported by a sworn itemized list.
rules.coverage_conditions: All residential lessors holding a security deposit.
rules.exemptions: Vacation or recreational leases or tenancies of 100 days or less.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Does not apply to vacation/recreational tenancies of 100 days or less.

rules.penalty: Forfeiture of right to retain any portion of deposit; treble damages plus 5% interest, court costs and reasonable attorney's fees.
rules.quoted_span: No deduction may be made from the security deposit for any purpose other than those set forth in this section.

rules.title: Transfer of security deposit and last month's rent to successor owner
rules.requirement: When a lessor transfers the property, the deposit (and any last month's rent advance) with accrued interest must be transferred to the successor, who must notify the tenant in writing within 45 days; a successor who does not receive the deposit is still liable for it.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential property transfers where a security deposit or last month's rent is held.
rules.exemptions: Successor liability does not apply to municipalities acquiring under ch. 60 or to state/federally chartered financial institution foreclosing mortgagees or mortgagees in possession; vacation tenancies of 100 days or less.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Successor liability exemption depends on successor type (municipality or chartered financial institution).

rules.penalty: Failure to transfer/comply forfeits right to retain deposit; treble damages plus 5% interest, costs and attorney's fees.
rules.quoted_span: The successor in interest shall, within forty-five days from the date of said transfer, notify the tenant who made such security deposit that such security deposit was transferred to him and that he is holding said security deposit.
